choices.name: Mind Shackle
choices.text: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 18" of the Psyker. That target unit is immediately Pinned until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Nightshroud
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain the benefit of Heavy Cover until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Psychic Maelstrom
choices.text: When this power is cast, place a single storm marker within 12" of the Psyker. Each time this Psychic Power is cast, remove any existing storm markers from the battlefield and place a new one within 12" of the Caster. When casting this Psychic Power, a Psyker can instead move the existing storm marker on a successful Psychic test instead of placing a new marker. The storm marker is moved 2D6" on a successful Psychic test. Units within 6" of the storm marker at the end of the Shooting Phase and each Movement Phase take 3D6, Strength 3, AP-, Automatic Hits.

choices.name: Telekinetic Dome
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any unit they are attached to gain a 5+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase. If the Psyker remained stationary in the previous Movement Phase, this becomes a 4+ Invulnerable save instead.

army_settings.name: Planetary Trait
army_settings.printed: A Genestealer Cult army must select one of the following Planetary traits to represent the world upon which the Cult is active.

options.name: Agri World
options.text: A Cult that is based on an Agri World gains the Skirmish special rule characteristic on all Infantry and Bike type units.

options.name: Death World
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Death World gains the Move Through Cover special rule on all Infantry and Bike type units.

options.name: Forge World
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Forge World gains the Bionics wargear (see Wargear section) on all Infantry and Bike type units in their army.

options.name: Hive World
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Hive World Infantry and Bike type units gain the Frenzy special rule.

options.name: Mining World
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Mining World gains +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic on all Infantry and Bike type units.

options.name: Shrine World
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Shrine World gains the Adamantium Will and Indomitable Spirit (5+) special rules on all Infantry and Bike type units.

options.name: Void Station
options.text: A Cult that is based on a Void Station replaces their Mining Suits for Void Armour on all units in their army. Void Armour confers a 4+ Armour save.
